jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
* IT \& Data
* Fulltime (40 uur)
* € 4\.672 \- € 6\.675
* Arnhem
* HBO


  
*Deze vacature sluit op 14 oktober 2026*


Wil jij software bouwen die direct bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van het Nederlandse hoogspanningsnet? Bij Qirion werk je aan FlowR, een applicatie die projectteams helpt om beter inzicht te krijgen in projecten binnen de hoogspanningsketen. Samen met een multidisciplinair DevOps\-team ontwikkel je moderne cloud\-native oplossingen die collega’s ondersteunen bij het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van het energienet van de toekomst. Deze positie staat open voor 32, 36 of 40 uur. Jij maakt het net innovatiever.


**Dit ga je doen**
------------------


*Please note that for this role we are searching for someone who is proficient in the use of the Dutch language (B2 level) and is already living in the Netherlands.*
  

  

**De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als full stack developer**


Qirion ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt het hoogspanningsnet van vandaag en morgen. Om de enorme opgave van de energietransitie mogelijk te maken, zijn betrouwbare digitale oplossingen essentieel. Als Full\-Stack Developer werk je binnen Team Paars aan FlowR: een applicatie die Project Managers, Lead Engineers en andere collega’s ondersteunt met inzicht in projecten en voortgang binnen Qirion.


Samen met je team zorg je ervoor dat de applicatie blijft meegroeien met de behoeften van de organisatie. Je werkt aan zowel frontend\- als backend\-oplossingen en draagt bij aan een veilig, stabiel en onderhoudbaar platform. Zo ben jij bezig met het:


* ontwikkelen en onderhouden van nieuwe en bestaande functionaliteiten binnen FlowR;
* bouwen van backend\-functionaliteit in een AWS\- en serverless\-omgeving;
* ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke frontend\-componenten met Angular, TypeScript, HTML en SCSS;
* vertalen van user stories en requirements naar onderhoudbare software\-oplossingen;
* samenwerken met Product Owner, Business Analist, UX Designer en developers om features en stories concreet en realiseerbaar te maken;
* schrijven van kwalitatieve, veilige en goed leesbare code;
* uitvoeren van code reviews en werken met Git en pull requests;
* meewerken aan unit testing en het verder ontwikkelen van testautomatisering;
* meedenken over gebruikerswaarde, onderhoudbaarheid, eenvoud en impact van oplossingen;
* verder ontwikkelen van kennis op het gebied van cloud\-native development, CI/CD, observability en DevOps\-principes.
  

  

**Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander**

Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Met een grote groep vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Dat doen we samen, met aandacht voor onze klant en met oog voor de toekomst. Dankzij onze mensen hebben we het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. En jij gaat dit doen


bij team Paars binnen Qirion, het onderdeel van Alliander dat verantwoordelijk is voor het ontwerpen, realiseren en onderhouden van het hoogspanningsnet. Binnen Team Paars werk je aan FlowR, een applicatie die helpt om inzicht en overzicht te creëren in projecten binnen de hoogspanningsketen.


Je maakt onderdeel uit van een multidisciplinair DevOps\-team bestaande uit een Product Owner, Business Analist, UX Designer, Scrum Master en developers. Het team beheert de applicatie zelf en werkt volgens het principe “you build it, you own it, you run it”. Daardoor heb je veel invloed op technische keuzes, nieuwe functionaliteiten en de doorontwikkeling van het platform.


Team Paars werkt hybride en komt iedere dinsdag en donderdag samen op kantoor in Duiven. De overige dagen werk je waar jij het meest effectief bent.  

  



**Jij maakt het net energieker**


Het helpt als je al ervaring hebt met onderwerpen zoals AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, AWS CDK, CI/CD\-pipelines, GitHub Actions, API\-ontwikkeling, integraties, observability, monitoring of DevOps\-praktijken. Heb je hier nog niet met alles gewerkt? Dan krijg je binnen Team Paars volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Werken aan een organisatie die toekomstproof is. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw technische leiderschap? En vul je dit daarnaast aan met:


* 3\+ jaren ervaring als Full\-Stack Developer, bij voorkeur binnen een Agile of Scrumteam;
* ervaring met TypeScript en een goede basis in HTML, CSS en/of SCSS;
* ervaring met Angular of een vergelijkbaar modern frontend framework;
* kennis van AWS\- en/of serverless\-technologieën;
* ervaring met Git, pull requests, code reviews en geautomatiseerd testen;
* goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve samenwerking met collega’s en stakeholders en een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

**Voor jou net beter geregeld**
-------------------------------


Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40‑urige werkweek:


* Aan de hand van kennis en ervaring een salaris van €4\.672 tot €6\.674 bruto per maand (schaal 9\)
* jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past;
* 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, aan te vullen met extra dagen die je vanuit je IKB koopt;
* een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris;
* elk jaar een DI‑budget van €700,\- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid.
* werken waar dit voor jou het beste werkt. Je werkt twee (vaste) dagen in de week op kantoor bij het team. De andere dagen mag je vanuit huis werken. Werk je vanuit huis, dan ontvang je hiervoor een thuiswerktegemoetkoming.
  

  

Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.  



  

**Voor jou net wat meer informatie**
------------------------------------


Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton. Bij grote aantallen sollicitaties kan de vacature eerder offline worden gehaald.

jobs.title: Sales Configurator Product Modeler / Developer
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Innovation Enablement Manager
\_\_


As a Sales Configurator Product Modeler / Developer you will be a member of a team developing and maintaining sales configurators solutions supporting the operations and customers of ABB Electrification (EL) \- Distribution Solution (ELDS) and Service (ELSE). You will be working in a cross\-functional team which operates in an international environment.


In this role you will be responsible for the modelling and maintenance of distribution systems and service products (switchgears, grid components and service offering ) in the new global ELDS/SE sales configurator platform(s). You will closely collaborate with product sales configurators, portfolio managers and engineers to design, implement, test and troubleshoot the product models. Together with the internal ABB IS and Business Teams you will have unique opportunity to learn the product portfolio and based on that design and deliver the future platform ensuring it meets the needs of our customers and sales team


The work model for the role is: \#hybrid; \#Li\-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

* Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot product models for ELDS and ELSE.
* Develop the product models as defined by the Product Managers / Sales Configurators Portfolio Managers and Engineers. Ensure product models are well\-structured to enable high quality change management and simplify the future maintenance
* Collaborate with relevant IS and Business stakeholders to deliver a user\-friendly and efficient Sales Configurator solution.
* Work closely with the platform supplier / implementation partner to ensure the integrity of the product model is guaranteed as the platform evolves.
* Provide technical support, troubleshooting and fixing issues reported by users.
* Contribute to the overall sales configurator development process


Qualifications for the role

* You are highly skilled in product modelling and configuration within sales configurator tools and enjoy working in the industrial technology and engineering sector
* You have established experience in the software development lifecycle, including working with tools such as Azure DevOps
* You possess solid expertise in programming languages such as .NET, Python, Java, or similar technologies
* You are highly adept in configurator platforms, with experience in Configit ACE considered an advantage
* You are passionate about teamwork and collaboration, while also demonstrating a proactive, solution\-oriented, and independent working style
* You are resilient in agile, fast\-paced environments and are motivated by continuous learning and development
* You have proven experience or a strong understanding of industrial product portfolios; knowledge of ABB’s DS and SE Division portfolio is considered a plus


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.




Ready to make an impact?


Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale.

The Impact You'll Have

Our backend teams cover a diverse range of domains, from core compute fabric resource management to service platforms and machine learning infrastructure. For example, you might work on challenges such as:

Supporting Databricks' growth by building foundational infrastructure platforms that enable seamless operation across numerous geographic regions and cloud providers.
Implementing cloud-agnostic infrastructure abstractions to help Databricks engineers more efficiently manage and operate their services.
Develop tools and processes that drive engineering efficiency at Databricks. We enhance the developer experience for Databricks engineers across various areas, including programming languages, linters, static analysis, IDEs, remote development environments, automated release pipelines, and test automation frameworks. Our current focus is on optimizing the Rust development experience across the organization.

What We Look For

2+ years of professional software development experience, or alternatively a PhD degree.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent experience.
Proficiency in one or more backend languages such as Java, Scala, or Go.
Hands-on experience in developing and operating backend systems.
Ability to contribute effectively throughout all project phases, from initial design and development to implementation and ongoing operations, with guidance from senior team members.
Self-driven and passionate with a strong focus on delivering impact through team collaboration.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation that drives alignment and decision-making.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, "Enrich connections. For good.", these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.
In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.
Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

The Role

Edenred is a global leader in payment solutions, offering innovative and efficient services that enhance the daily lives of individuals and businesses. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are seeking a talented Level 2 .Net Backend Developer to join our dynamic team.

Responsibilities:

Assist in designing and developing software solutions under guidance.
Work with the team to implement experiments and learn from data-driven insights.
Write clean and maintainable code with support from peers and mentors.
Seek opportunities to learn from more experienced developers.
Participate in code reviews to learn coding standards and improve code quality.
Follow and adopt best practices in software development.
Contribute to discussions about architecture and design within the team.
Embrace a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement by sharing ideas and feedback.

Your Profile:

As a .Net Backend Developer working in a multidisciplinary squad
, you will contribute directly to the company wide objectives with your involvement across different team layers.
3-6 Years experience in .Net Development
At the squad layer, you will work with your product, data, and design counterparts and other stakeholders to discover, ideate, conduct experiments, and solve customer problems.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Merkle powers the experience economy. For more than 35 years, the company has put people at the heart of its approach to digital business transformation. As the world's only integrated experience consultancy with a heritage in data science and business performance, Merkle delivers holistic, end-to-end experiences that drive growth, engagement, and loyalty. With more than 16,000 employees, Merkle operates in 30+ countries throughout the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

In Bulgaria, we manage a global client portfolio, providing a single source of expertise, technology, and operational support. We have a proven track record for delivering, managing, and innovating multi-channel commerce platforms for major international brands and retailers, including adidas, Clarins, ASDA, Shiseido, and more. Our world-class team has delivered sites for over 35 brands, including more than 400 transactional e-commerce sites across 60 locations on 6 continents. Our scope is expanding with new data engineering practices, paid search and social advertising, and SEO. We look forward to what's next.

We're hiring a Azure Platform Engineer
as part of Merkle in Sofia.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Azure Platform Engineer to help build, configure, and support enterprise-grade Azure platforms. This is a hands-on role focused primarily on Azure PaaS services, requiring someone who can work independently, interpret architecture documentation, and deliver secure, production-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Deploy and manage Azure PaaS services across development, test, and production environments.
Configure application hosting services, networking, security, monitoring, and private connectivity.
Implement Azure platform components according to established architecture and governance standards.
Troubleshoot platform, networking, and deployment issues.
Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, and operational requirements.
Document implementations and collaborate with architects and engineering teams.

Required Experience

Strong hands-on experience with Azure PaaS services.
Experience deploying and supporting enterprise-scale Azure environments.
Ability to work independently with minimal guidance.
Strong knowledge of Azure networking, security, and platform services.

Technical Skills

Experience with most of the following:

Azure App Service, Functions, Container Apps, Container Registry
Azure Front Door, WAF, API Management
Virtual Networks, NSGs, NAT Gateway, Private Endpoints, Private DNS
Managed Identity, Key Vault, App Configuration
Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, Data Factory
Application Insights, Log Analytics, Azure Monitoring and Alerting

Nice to Have

Knowledge aligned with:

AZ-104 Azure Administrator
AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer
AZ-700 Azure Network Engineer
AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect

What do we offer:

We are huge believers in the balance of work, so we offer all our employees 25 days of paid leave and 3 fixed well-being days off a year.
A hybrid work model for our teams so they can work from the office or the comfort of their home.
Free parking spaces for all our employees working from the office.
Complimentary drinks and snacks in the office to keep the energy levels up.
Parent-friendly culture and potential for additional days off to create new memories with your loved ones.
Life Insurance, Health and dental insurance plan or, if selected, gift vouchers instead.
Sports card, partially covered by the company and food vouchers.
2 days off for volunteering and numerous charity initiatives throughout the year.
Opportunity to attend training, conferences and get certification sponsored by the company upon availability and business need.

About dentsu:

Taking a people-centred approach to business transformation, we use insights to connect brand, content, commerce and experience, underpinned by modern creativity. As part of Dentsu Group Inc., we are headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and our 65,000-employee base of dedicated professionals works across four regions (Japan, Americas, EMEA and APAC). Dentsu combines Japanese innovation with a diverse, global perspective to drive client growth and to shape society.
